name: Alexander Stamps and Coin Limited
about: Alexander Stamps and Coin Limited engages in the philatelic and numismatic activities worldwide. The company trades in stamps, coins, antique items, paper money, medals, postcards, photos, autographs, newspapers, and numismatic collection. It is also involved in trade of historical evidence, maps, artifacts, handwritten religious books, and articles through e-commerce. Alexander Stamps and Coin Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Vadodara, India.
